_comment: The words on the game's screens and in its messages that every screen shares; each screen's own are in its
ui_<screen>.json. A label is said one way (the first line of its pool). {name} is a value the game fills in.
language.name: this language's name in the Settings picker; a translation (text/<language>/) gives its own.
format.percent: a share in whole percent, {percent} the number (0 to 100; {percent:0} writes it without decimals).

lines.language.name: English
lines.settings.language.restart: The game will speak {language} the next time it starts.
lines.settings.restart.title: Restart Needed
lines.settings.not_saved: The settings could not be saved. The details are in the log.
